approved_draft.why_this_matters: A decision reached through one's own careful reasoning is trusted far more than one taken under pressure, which is exactly what makes a decision built on selected inputs so hard to revisit later.
approved_draft.what_it_is_not: Everyone decides on incomplete information, and negotiators, advertisers and friends all present the facts that favour their case. This describes a sustained effort to shape another party's whole information picture, not the ordinary selectivity of anyone making an argument.

approved_draft.why_this_matters: Retaliation, suspicion and public anger land on a group that did not do the thing, and the record that would correct it is the very thing that was arranged.
approved_draft.what_it_is_not: This is one of the most over-claimed ideas in circulation: most disputed events are genuinely confusing in their first days, and unanswered questions after an incident are normal rather than proof of staging. The documented cases were established through archives and investigation years afterwards, never through pattern-spotting in real time.
approved_draft.note: Leaned the disconfirming case towards warning against over-diagnosis, since this term is far more often misapplied than correctly applied.
